e.title: survPen
e.summary: 多维惩罚样条（超额）风险模型与相对死亡率比（CRAN 2.0.5）
e.summary_en: Multidimensional penalized splines for (excess) hazard and relative mortality ratio models (CRAN 2.0.5)
e.summary_hk: 多維懲罰樣條（超額）風險模型與相對死亡率比（CRAN 2.0.5）
e.body:
survPen（CRAN 2.0.5，2026-06-09 更新）用多维惩罚回归样条拟合（超额）风险模型、**相对死亡率比模型**与复发事件的边际强度模型：可同时处理时变效应、非线性效应与多个连续协变量之间的交互，并且因为显式推导似然导数而**又快又稳**；关键在于它把「期望死亡率」内建进模型，直接输出净生存（net survival）与超额风险估计。作者为 Mathieu Fauvernier 等，方法见 Fauvernier et al. (2019a, JOSS；2019b, JRSS-C)。对 RIAA：寿险/健康险「相对死亡率」建模的标准开源实现——与 [[lifelines]]、[[scikit-survival]]、[[pycox]] 构成生存分析工具矩阵（后三者偏通用/机器学习，survPen 偏超额风险与人群对照）；可与 [[actxps]]（经验研究）、[[stmomo]] 与 [[hmdhfdplus]]（死亡率数据与随机死亡率模型）、[[mortsoa]] 串成完整链路；适合寿险定价、长寿风险与健康险方向。

## 同类工具
[[tidyextreme]]、[[tree-like-pin]]、[[two-factor-vasicek-python]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
survPen (CRAN 2.0.5, updated 2026-06-09) fits (excess) hazard models, **relative mortality ratio** models and marginal intensity models for recurrent events using multidimensional penalized regression splines: it handles time-dependent effects, non-linear effects and interactions among several continuous covariates at once, and is fast and stable thanks to explicit computation of likelihood derivatives. Crucially it builds expected mortality into the model, returning net survival and excess hazard estimates directly. Authors: Mathieu Fauvernier et al.; see Fauvernier et al. (2019a, JOSS; 2019b, JRSS-C). For RIAA: the standard open-source implementation of relative-mortality modelling for life/health insurance — together with [[lifelines]], [[scikit-survival]] and [[pycox]] it forms a survival-analysis toolkit (the latter three are general/ML-oriented, survPen is excess-risk and population-reference oriented); it chains with [[actxps]] (experience studies), [[stmomo]] and [[hmdhfdplus]] (mortality data and stochastic mortality models) and [[mortsoa]]; suits life pricing, longevity risk and health insurance.

e.body_hk:
survPen（CRAN 2.0.5，2026-06-09 更新）用多維懲罰回歸樣條擬合（超額）風險模型、**相對死亡率比模型**與復發事件的邊際強度模型：可同時處理時變效應、非線性效應與多個連續協變量之間的交互，且因顯式推導似然導數而**又快又穩**；關鍵在於把「期望死亡率」內建進模型，直接輸出淨生存與超額風險估計。作者為 Mathieu Fauvernier 等。對 RIAA：壽險/健康險「相對死亡率」建模的標準開源實現——與 [[lifelines]]、[[scikit-survival]]、[[pycox]] 構成生存分析工具矩陣；可與 [[actxps]]、[[stmomo]]、[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[mortsoa]] 串成完整鏈路；適合壽險定價、長壽風險與健康險方向。
